# Vicem — Diet the Context, Pass the Baton

> **Hit Claude Code's 5-hour quota mid-feature? Or watching Cursor / Codex slow to a crawl after 150k tokens of context rot?** > > **Vicem** compacts your active coding session by **80–99%** (via deterministic AST code skeletonization + lossless MCP on-demand rehydration) and hands off a clean `.vicem/BATON.md` across **Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Antigravity IDE, and Web AI** in 3 seconds — with **`0` npm dependencies** and **`0` network calls**. > > ⭐ **Tip:** Click **Star** (top-right) to bookmark this repo for the next time your coding agent hits a 5-hour quota limit or context rot. --- ## ⚡ 10-Second Quick Start (`npx` — Zero Install) ### 1. Run the Local Desktop Utility GUI or Pass a Baton Immediately ```bash # Launch the local Desktop Utility GUI (12 agents, 4-stage pipeline inspector, live token/quota HUD) npx -y vicem-cli gui # Or pack a compressed baton from your current repo & hand off in 1 command npx -y vicem-cli codex npx -y vicem-cli claude npx -y vicem-cli cursor # Or auto-configure global `vicem` CLI + MCP servers across all installed agents npx -y vicem-cli setup ``` ### 2. Add as an MCP Server in 1 Line (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor) ```bash # Claude Code claude mcp add vicem -- npx -y vicem-cli mcp # OpenAI Codex CLI codex mcp add vicem -- npx -y vicem-cli mcp ```
Cursor / Windsurf / Claude Desktop (mcp.json config) Add to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`, `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json`, or `claude_desktop_config.json`: ```json { "mcpServers": { "vicem": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "vicem-cli", "mcp"] } } } ```

🌐 Try Zero-Install Browser Sandbox (GitHub Pages) · 📦 npm (vicem-cli / @rakkunn/vicem) · 🔒 Security & Zero-Network Proof

--- ## Visual Overview

![Vicem 3-Second Context Baton & Diet Demo](./demo.gif) ```text $ npx -y vicem-cli codex ╭─ VICEM CONTEXT BATON & DIET RECEIPT ──────────────────────────────────╮ │ Source Session : Claude Code (sess-9f3a2c · 42 turns harvested) │ │ Context Diet : 184,200 tok ($2.76) ──► 14,800 tok ($0.22) [-91.9%] │ │ Code Skeletons : 18 files compressed (31 bodies indexed in ledger) │ │ Security Guard : 2 secrets redacted (OPENAI_KEY, AWS_ACCESS_KEY) │ │ Relay Target : OpenAI Codex CLI (interactive TTY handoff ready) │ ╰───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯ [OK] [Vicem] Baton written to .vicem/BATON.md (182ms). Launching codex... ``` --- ## How Lossless Code Skeletonization + MCP Rehydration Works Instead of lossy LLM summarization that forgets exact type contracts, Vicem keeps all imports, types, and signatures 100% intact inside `.vicem/BATON.md` while collapsing unchanged function bodies `>= 12` lines into `.vicem/ledger.json`: ```ts // What the receiving agent sees in .vicem/BATON.md (-85% tokens, disk file untouched): export interface JwtPayload { sub: string; exp: number; role: 'admin' | 'user'; } export async function verifySessionToken(rawToken: string, secret: string): Promise { /* ... */ } ``` When the receiving agent actually needs to edit `verifySessionToken`, it calls the MCP tool **`vicem_rehydrate("src/auth.ts", "verifySessionToken")`** to pull back the exact raw lines on demand (with automatic git HEAD and live-file SHA-256 staleness detection). | Pipeline Stage | Before Vicem (Raw Session) | After Vicem Baton & Diet | Token Savings | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1. Session Handoff** | 40+ turns of raw JSONL / SQLite history locked in one tool | Extracts `Goal`, `Done`, `Immediate NEXT` & `git diff` into `.vicem/BATON.md` | **< 3s handoff** across 12+ CLI, IDE & Web AI agents | | **2. Code Skeletonizer** | Full source files with unchanged function bodies (`~120,000 tok`) | Signatures & types 100% intact; bodies indexed in `.vicem/ledger.json` | **-80% to -90% code tokens** (lossless via `vicem_rehydrate`) | | **3. Test & Log Slimmer** | Verbose ANSI spinners & `node_modules` stack frames (`~45,000 tok`) | Failing assertion + top 5 user-code stack frames (`~1,200 tok`) | **-95% log noise** | | **4. Data & Noise Gate** | Lockfiles, build bundles, and huge JSON / CSV / SQL dumps | Lockfiles dropped; data files reduced to inferred schema + 2 sample rows | **-98% data bloat** | | **5. Safety & Secret Guard** | Plaintext `.env` keys in logs & risk of placeholder overwrites | Local secret redaction + `SkeletonWriteGuard` pre-commit protection | **0 leaked secrets** & **0 npm dependencies** | --- ## Direct CLI Commands & Offline Source Setup ```bash # 1. Launch the interactive Desktop Utility GUI vicem gui # 2. Compact current bloated session in-place (Context Rot Rescue) vicem self # 3. Pass baton to any CLI, IDE, or Web AI target vicem codex | vicem claude | vicem gemini | vicem cursor | vicem windsurf | vicem vscode | vicem web # 4. Return baton to previous agent & auto-unmount temporary rules vicem back # 5. Extract & smart-patch code blocks from a Web AI clipboard reply vicem land # 6. Run <50ms environment & agent storage diagnostics vicem doctor ```
Offline / Air-Gapped Source Clone Installer (No npm required) ```bash git clone https://github.com/RAKKUNN/vicem.git && cd vicem ./vicem.mjs setup # or double-click setup.command (macOS/Linux) / setup.bat (Windows) ``` For browser-only air-gapped environments without Node.js, open **`index.html`** directly in Chrome, Edge, Brave, or Safari (enforced by `connect-src 'none'` CSP).
--- ## Supply-Chain Verification & Minimal TCB Verify zero third-party dependencies and cryptographic artifact integrity in one command: ```bash # 1. Confirm zero npm dependencies node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json')).dependencies ?? '0 dependencies')" # 2. Verify SHA-256 checksums of all core artifacts shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS # 3. Run the 52-test automated suite node --test test/*.test.mjs ```

How Lossless Code Skeletonization + MCP Rehydration Works

// What the receiving agent sees in .vicem/BATON.md (-85% tokens, disk file untouched):

export interface JwtPayload { sub: string; exp: number; role: 'admin' | 'user'; }

export async function verifySessionToken(rawToken: string, secret: string): Promise<JwtPayload> { /* ... */ }

When the receiving agent actually needs to edit verifySessionToken, it calls the MCP tool vicem_rehydrate("src/auth.ts", "verifySessionToken") to pull back the exact raw lines on demand (with automatic git HEAD and live-file SHA-256 staleness detection).

| 4. Data & Noise Gate | Lockfiles, build bundles, and huge JSON / CSV / SQL dumps | Lockfiles dropped; data files reduced to inferred schema + 2 sample rows | -98% data bloat |

| 5. Safety & Secret Guard | Plaintext .env keys in logs & risk of placeholder overwrites | Local secret redaction + SkeletonWriteGuard pre-commit protection | 0 leaked secrets & 0 npm dependencies |
